```yaml
name: CLI Publish and Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'cli/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/cli-publish.yml'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        node-version: [18]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build CLI
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cli-build-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: dist/

  publish-npm:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build CLI
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: pnpm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

  publish-github:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download all build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts/

      - name: Create release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.0
          release_name: CLI v1.0.0
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

  run-doctor-diagnostics:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run doctor diagnostics
        run: |
          pnpm doctor
          echo "Doctor diagnostics completed successfully"

  fuzzy-search-validation:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Validate fuzzy search functionality
        run: |
          pnpm search python-pro
          pnpm search terraform
          echo "Fuzzy search validation completed successfully"

  code-coverage:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run coverage
        run: pnpm coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
```
